title: Verify pins the Playwright MCP version, prints it in preflight, honours the override
purpose: Cover the four ACs on US-1101: the pinned constant + composed default MCP config, the preflight stderr line, the override notice + non-semver refusal, and the default pin lands on the report as runStats.playwrightMcpVersion.

testCases.description: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_VERSION is exported as a semver string, not @latest
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/engine/launcher.test.js::PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_VERSION is exported as a semver string and is NOT @latest

testCases.description: DEFAULT_MCP_CONFIG.args composes @playwright/mcp with the pinned version and never @latest
rcf verify run prints one preflight line naming the effective @playwright/mcp pin on stderr
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/cli/run.test.js::run: preflight prints the pinned Playwright MCP version to stderr

testCases.description: --playwright-mcp-version fires the loud stderr override notice and records the effective pin on the report
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/cli/run.test.js::run: --playwright-mcp-version fires the loud override notice AND lands on the report

testCases.description: --playwright-mcp-version with a non-semver value refuses exit 2 with the spec-named message
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/cli/run.test.js::run: --playwright-mcp-version with a non-semver value refuses exit 2 with the spec-named message

testCases.description: Even with no override the report records the default pin as runStats.playwrightMcpVersion
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/cli/run.test.js::run: default pin lands on the report as runStats.playwrightMcpVersion even with no override
